purpose: Reassess the joint W/L primitive-demand path against the exact qualified Core 0.20/0.21 authority and the user's graph-first/no-freestyle requirement. This audit changes no W or L closure state and promotes no semantic primitive.

findings.subject: DNWF necessity argument
evidence: research/primitive-logic/PRIMITIVE_LOGIC_KERNEL_0_1.md explicitly labels itself an unqualified supporting candidate.
Core 0.20 qualification records the exact Core 0.20 candidate as the qualified semantic target; Experiment 048 does not include or promote the supporting Primitive Logic Kernel.
Core 0.21 qualification adds no recursion primitive and states recursion is represented through existing primitive logical/relational structure.
findings.conclusion: K7 cannot be used as qualified authority for the claim that a new WF_TERM_ALGEBRA semantic primitive is forced. DNWF 0.1 remains useful historical research evidence and independently has terminal Q7 DOES_NOT_QUALIFY, but its 'only forced primitive' premise must be re-derived from exact qualified authority.

findings.subject: PRIMITIVE_DEMAND_GRAPH_0_1 and CANDIDATE_PRIMITIVE_BASIS_0_1
evidence: DEMAND_EXTRACTION_RULES_0_1.json freezes 31 hand-authored regex demand categories before extraction.
Those same rules contain requires arrays naming candidate basis IDs before PRIMITIVE_DEMAND_GRAPH_0_1 is generated.
generate_joint_primitive_demand_graph.mjs mechanically reproduces the predeclared category matches and copies the predeclared requires sets into graph demand nodes.
Candidate-basis minimality is therefore downstream of assumptions already embedded in the extractor rather than independent graph emergence.
findings.conclusion: The v0.1 demand graph is reproducible diagnostic evidence, but it is not admissible evidence that its candidate primitive basis was selected by W/L graph structure.

findings.subject: unresolved W/L native compilation
evidence: Open W items in WOIT_NATIVE_COMPILATION_MANIFEST_REGROUNDED_0_24.json are INCOMPLETE_UNEXPANDED routing shells pointing to frozen SSC bodies.
Open L items in LISI_NATIVE_COMPILATION_MANIFEST_REGROUNDED_0_36.json are likewise INCOMPLETE_UNEXPANDED routing shells.
Their current native body roots do not expose the internal load-bearing operation/relation incidence needed for structural quotienting.
findings.conclusion: A neutral source-body-to-unexpanded-operation graph compilation stage is required before any lawful cross-track primitive-demand quotient can be claimed.

required_replacement_order: Pin the exact 84 W + 151 L unresolved frozen bodies and exact qualified Core authority.

Create a complete per-body occurrence census of every load-bearing non-Core operation/relation occurrence, preserving exact source spans and argument/dependency incidence without assigning candidate primitive categories.

Compile those occurrences to a neutral graph using only qualified Core logical/structural roles plus explicitly marked UNEXPANDED semantic occurrences; source-domain names may identify provenance but may not determine quotient class.
Mechanically classify each occurrence as reducible under exact qualified Core, or unresolved with the exact missing semantic definition/authority.
Canonicalize only by alpha-renaming and exact incidence/dependency graph isomorphism. Do not quotient by regex category, conventional mathematical label, or desired W/L correspondence.
Only after the quotient exists, synthesize candidate reusable schemas/extensions from uncovered quotient classes.
Freeze and independently qualify each candidate as its own project before either W or L may consume it.
Re-run W/L closure and continue to recursive IA only after complete Core 0.21 closure.
nonclaims: This audit does not prove that no new semantic extension will be required.
This audit does not prove DNWF semantics false.
This audit does not identify any W/L cross-author correspondence.
This audit does not reopen or alter any previously closed W or L census item.
